fields.inlineHelpText: This formula field combines the values of the Publication Title and Edition fields. The Publication Title is a picklist field that displays the title of the publication, and the Edition field displays the edition number. The combination of these two fields is displayed in the format of "Publication Title - Edition" and can be used to quickly identify the specific publication and edition in question. This field is automatically populated and can not be edited.
fields.label: Publication Title Edition
fields.name: Publication_Title_Edition__c

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
AND(
NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Event__c))),
NOT(ISBLANK(Edition__c))
),
TEXT(Event__c) & " " & Edition__c,
NULL
)
fields.inlineHelpText: This formula field combines the values of the Event and Edition fields. The Event is a picklist field that displays the title of the Event, and the Edition field displays the edition number/year. The combination of these two fields is displayed in the format of "Event - Edition" and can be used to quickly identify the specific publication and edition in question. This field is automatically populated and can not be edited.
fields.label: Event Title Edition
